title: How to Protect Photos Online Before You Share Them
description: Learn how to protect photos before sharing them online by removing metadata, blurring sensitive details, pixelating private areas, and adding watermarks.
seo_title: How to Protect Photos Online Before Sharing | NanoImage
meta_description: Protect photos online before sharing. Remove EXIF metadata, blur faces or addresses, pixelate private areas, and add watermarks in your browser.
